title: Summer Time Rendering
description: Upon hearing of Ushio’s death, Shinpei returns to his hometown of Wakayama City on Hitogashima and reunites with his childhood friend’s family. The funeral goes smoothly, but under the surface something strange is brewing on the island. What mysteries await him on this secluded summer island?

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x1
episodes_data.description: Shinpei returns home for his friend Ushio's funeral. She apparently drowned, but something is off.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x2
episodes_data.description: To find out the truth about Ushio's death, Shinpei and Mio head to Hiruko.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x3
episodes_data.description: After being stabbed by Mio's shadow, Shinpei regains consciousness at the docks on July 22nd.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x4
episodes_data.description: Ushio's shadow appears before Shinpei at the summer festival.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x5
episodes_data.description: A giant shadow massacres everyone at the Hitogashima Summer Festival and engulfs the whole island.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x6
episodes_data.description: Hizuru Minakata, the woman on the ferry, returns to Hitogashima Island hoping to solve a mystery.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x7
episodes_data.description: In order to defeat the Kobayakawa's shadows, Shinpei and Hizuru join forces with Nezu.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x8
episodes_data.description: Mio's shadow appears before Shinpei and threatens him with a knife.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x9
episodes_data.description: In a video, Ushio and her shadow recount their encounter up to the moment the video is recorded.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x10
episodes_data.description: Shinpei gains clues on Mount Takanosu since Ushio and her shadow had gone there.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x11
episodes_data.description: Ushio, Sou and Shinpei are surrounded by shadows.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x12
episodes_data.description: Tokiko, Sou's younger sister, reveals she has been offering corpses as food to Hiruko.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x13
episodes_data.description: It is the fifth July 22nd for Shinpei. Hizuru takes time to process that Shinpei is a time traveler.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x14
episodes_data.description: Shinpei finds himself in Hizuru's memories from fourteen years ago.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x15
episodes_data.description: Heine, who loops like Shinpei, realizes the pattern of behavior when a new loop begins.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x16
episodes_data.description: Mio proposes to turn the shadows into allies.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x17
episodes_data.description: Shinpei hears about Shide's identity from Sou's father, Director of Hishigata Clinic.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x18
episodes_data.description: A seventy-year-old photograph reveals the truth.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x19
episodes_data.description: Karikiri and Heine strike. Mio and Hizuru learn of Ushio's death.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x20
episodes_data.description: Hizuru and Karikiri face off, while Gil and Rose enter the fray.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x21
episodes_data.description: Shinpei despairs over Hizuru's death. However, hope is on the horizon.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x22
episodes_data.description: Ushio fully comes back to life. Shinpei heads to Hiruko's grotto.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x23
episodes_data.description: After slicing down Heine, Shide brings Shinpei and Ushio to her home.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x24
episodes_data.description: After a fierce battle, Shinpei takes the place of an exhausted Ushio and confronts Shide.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time Rendering 1x25
episodes_data.description: Shide is gone and Ushio's final iteration must vanish. Shinpei comes to on the morning of July 22nd.
